Maya Patel: Quick sync — I'm planning a hygiene run to re-bucket onboarding_status into 4 micro-buckets and attach a daily sample (n=200) for CSAT pinging + manual review. Draft SQL below, doing a dry-run Wed 11:00 PT. Looking for feedback on risk thresholds and which playbook to attach.

Maya Patel: ```sql
-- select candidates for csat sampling and risk tagging
SELECT account_id, arr, onboarding_status, last_active_at,
  CASE
    WHEN onboarding_status IN ('invited','started') THEN 'early'
    WHEN onboarding_status = 'in_progress' AND last_active_at < now() - interval '7 days' THEN 'stalled'
    WHEN onboarding_status = 'completed' AND arr < 5000 THEN 'lowARR_post'
    ELSE 'healthy'
  END AS micro_bucket
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE deleted = false
  AND created_at > now() - interval '180 days'
ORDER BY arr DESC
LIMIT 10000;
```

Ben Ortiz: +1 to sampling but we should stratify by ARR tiers. For renewal risk we should mark 'stalled' only if last_activity < 14 days for enterprise (>50k ARR) :thinking_face:

Lina Gomez: Agree on ARR stratification. Also prefer the 'stalled' bucket to trigger a 'reactivation' playbook for ARR <50k and 'AM-touch' playbook for >50k.

Sam Wu: Add `opt_out_email` check so we don't spam. Also suggest we record `sample_reason` field on account row for traceability. Could we sample 30% from stalled and 10% from healthy? keeps manual work sane.

ops-bot: scheduled job created: cs_hygiene_bucketer_daily at 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z (dry-run)

Maya Patel: Thanks — I'll update the SQL, add ARR stratification and opt_out filter, and create a small dashboard for sampled list. I'll post the dry-run results in this thread after Wed run. :calendar:

Ben Ortiz: If dry-run looks good, can we wire an automatic playbook assignment and Slack notify to AMs? small webhook should do it.

Maya Patel: Yup — plan is: 1) dry-run Wed, 2) review sampling dashboard Thur morning, 3) enable assignments Fri if false positives <5%.

Lina Gomez: tagging: @Sam Wu for opt-out checks, @Ben Ortiz for webhook, @Maria Chen for playbook mapping FYI

Sam Wu: on it. I'll add the opt_out check by EOD today.

Maya Patel: Awesome — thanks everyone.
